items.title: Walmart (WMT) Faces An Oppenheimer Downgrade, Is A 28% Undervalued View Still Credible?
items.summary: Walmart (WMT) is back in focus after Oppenheimer shifted its rating to Perform from Outperform ahead of the August 20 earnings release, citing pharmacy related headwinds and what it views as a full valuation. Walmart's share price has cooled from its all time high earlier in the year, with a 90 day share price return down 14.25%, even as the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 13.26% and the 5 year total shareholder return stands at 139.91%.
